-- GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating 
AS(
    SELECT
    BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID,
    BCM.DTDATE1,
    BCM.STRTEXT21,
    BCM.STRTEXT27,
    BCM.STRTEXT20,
    BCMD.RECORD_STATUS,
    BCM.INSERT_DTTM,
    BCM.BANK_ID

    FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO_DELTA BCMD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO BCM on BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID = BCMD.MISCELLANEOUSID AND BCMD.BANK_ID = BCM.BANK_ID AND BCM.isLatest = '1'

),

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MG5', CONCAT(
    MISCELLANEOUSID,
    DTDATE1,
    STRTEXT21,
    STRTEXT27,
    STRTEXT20
    )) HASHROW, MISCELLANEOUSID, RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating  WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerId,
    PeriodStartDate,
    CreditRiskId,
    CustomerCreditRatingNote,
    RiskRatingTypeId
    )) HASHROW, CustomerId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating
    
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.MISCELLANEOUSID,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT TGT ON SRC.MISCELLANEOUSID = TGT.CustomerId 
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW = TGT.HASHROW
)

UPDATE TGT
SET
[CustomerId] = SRC.MISCELLANEOUSID,
[CreditRatingAgencyId] = NULL,
[PeriodStartDate] = SRC.DTDATE1,
[PeriodEndDate] = NULL,
[CreditRiskId] = SRC.STRTEXT21,
[CustomerCreditRatingNote] = SRC.STRTEXT27,
[RiskRatingTypeId] = SRC.STRTEXT20,
[SourceCode] = 'CRM',
[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BANK_ID,
[WorkflowId] = 0,
[TaskRunId] = 0,
[InsertDttm] = SRC.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating TGT
JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId;


--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating
AS(
    SELECT
    BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID,
    BCM.DTDATE1,
    BCM.STRTEXT21,
    BCM.STRTEXT27,
    BCM.STRTEXT20,
    BCMD.RECORD_STATUS,
    BCM.INSERT_DTTM,
    BCM.BANK_ID
    
    FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO_DELTA BCMD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO BCM ON BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID = BCMD.MISCELLANEOUSID AND BCM.BANK_ID = BCMD.BANK_ID AND BCM.isLatest = '1'
)

--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating (
    [CustomerId], 
    [CreditRatingAgencyId], 
    [PeriodStartDate], 
    [PeriodEndDate], 
    [CreditRiskId], 
    [CustomerCreditRatingNote], 
    [RiskRatingTypeId],
    [SourceCode],
    [WorkFlowId],
    [TaskRunId],
    [InsertDttm]
    )

    SELECT
    MISCELLANEOUSID as CustomerId,
    NULL AS CreditRatingAgencyId,
    DTDATE1 AS PeriodStartDate,
    NULL AS PeriodEndDate,
    STRTEXT21 AS CreditRiskId,
    STRTEXT27 AS CustomerCreditRatingNote,
    STRTEXT20 AS RiskRatingTypeId,
    'CRM' AS SOURCECODE,
    BANK_ID AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId,
    0 AS WORKFLOWID,
    0 AS TASKRUNID,
    INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');
